{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed orders count toward conversion)
completed_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check conversion rate by channel
email_conv_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference
difference = email_conv_rate - paid_search_conv_rate

print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_conv_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_conv_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
